hypothesis: A top-one retrieval gain may not transfer to attention weighted-value outputs. Evaluate the quantum attention operation softmax(beta*fidelity) @ V directly and calibrate beta on separate validation episodes.
scope: 5 fixed trained maps, 80 validation/256 test episodes per seed, 8 keys and 4-dimensional random values, B512/query,20 measurement repeats. Noisy shot estimates here mean finite shots from ideal probabilities, not gate noise.
calibration_cost: 80*512*20 = 819200 validation shots per seed per allocation method; all beta choices reuse those samples. This overhead is not free and must be amortized before claiming resource savings.
